verdict.rationale: The pack documents first-party 'Client SDKs', guides for sending events (including sending directly to mParticle), and IDSync for managing known and anonymous identities across apps and platforms. Community posts confirm app event collection. Most evidence is page titles only, so the web/mobile/server SDK breadth and any documented track/identify/page tracking spec are not substantiated. missing for 10: explicit per-platform SDK coverage (web, iOS/Android, server), a documented event spec equivalent to track/identify/page, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK collection

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: Send your first event to mParticle
IDSync gives visibility into, and control over, the management of known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms.
Now we have mParticle, so we can send data only to mParticle
